Dad: What will each pupil do if the group stays indoors?
Eva: Leo will compare leaf shapes.
Dad: Will Jo take photos?
Eva: No, Jo will read the guidebook. Sam will take photos.
Dad: What about Ruby?
Eva: Ruby will write labels for the display.
Dad: And Alex?
Eva: Alex will arrange the leaves on the table. He will not draw the lake.
Dad: Will anyone check the boat times?
Eva: Not today. We will use this indoor plan if it rains.
